tables.title: Bayesian Contingency Table Test
notes: Sampling plan: joint multinomial (total fixed). Prior concentration a = 1.00.
BF₁₀ compares association (H₁) with independence (H₀) (Gunel & Dickey, 1974).

interpretation.text: A Bayesian test of association between spontaneous and case (joint multinomial (total fixed)) found that the data are 5.12 × 10⁵ times more likely under H₁ (the variables are associated) than under H₀ (they are independent): BF₁₀ = 5.12 × 10⁵, extreme evidence for H₁.

title: Bayesian Contingency Table
code:
library(BayesFactor)
library(ggnext)
# Bayesian contingency table: spontaneous by case
d <- subset(data, !is.na(spontaneous) & !is.na(case))
d$spontaneous <- factor(d$spontaneous, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("0", "1", "2 or more"))
d$case <- factor(d$case, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Case"))
tab <- table(d$spontaneous, d$case, dnn = c("spontaneous", "case"))
bf <- contingencyTableBF(tab, sampleType = "jointMulti", priorConcentration = 1)
bf10 <- extractBF(bf)$bf
# Posterior log odds ratio (2 x 2 tables): from the posterior cell probabilities
if (all(dim(tab) == 2)) {
  set.seed(123)
  post <- posterior(bf, iterations = 10000, progress = FALSE)
  cell <- function(i, j) as.numeric(post[, paste0("pi[", i, ",", j, "]")])
  log_or <- log(cell(1, 1)) + log(cell(2, 2)) - log(cell(1, 2)) - log(cell(2, 1))
}
p <- ggnext(d, aes(spontaneous, color = case)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "spontaneous by case", x = "Prior spontaneous abortions", y = "Count") +
  theme_modern()
